name: Monument
intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor, you're ready to do some damage to yourself. Make your engineers proud.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch you dash into a colleague.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.tale: The LED drum lights each bend. Step off the high road onto a car: gravity is company policy.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.tale: The road runs through the portal tower at the sixth floor. Take your write-off up there; ignore the view.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Stand near it until a colleague finds you.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.tale: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Build the same way: one hit, then another, quickly.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.tale: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Legs 1 is fitted: jump into a car between them.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.tale: The gateway thanked the car that wrote you off for driving safely. Let one colleague throw you into the next.
